subject: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: kickoff, MAP, and QBR availability
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme-corp.com>; Luke Bennett <luke.bennett@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Aug 2028 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: kickoff, MAP, and QBR availability

Hi Sarah, Luke —

Hope you both had a good week. We are starting the renewal and capacity uplift conversation for Acme (contract renewal date: 2028-10-15) and want to align on timeline, stakeholders, and a QBR slot to review the mutual action plan (MAP). High-level ask:

- Confirm primary decision owner(s) for terms and capacity (licenses, throughput).
- Share any updated projections for peak tokens/day and embedding usage for H2.
- Tell us if there are procurement timing constraints (finance/legal deadlines).

Proposed near-term schedule (flexible):
- Week of Aug 7: internal scoping and draft MAP delivered by Redwood
- Week of Aug 14: joint QBR to review MAP, capacity projections, and commercial options
- Aug 21–Sep 8: negotiation window / SOW and signature cadence

Please pick two 60-minute windows that work for your team next week (we will aim to block a QBR and invite the right Redwoods). Suggested slots: Aug 9 10–11am ET, Aug 10 2–3pm ET, Aug 11 11–12pm ET.

Attached: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP), capacity_projection_Q3-Q4.csv (our initial ask). I've also added Marissa (CS lead) and Grace (sales engineering) to help with runbook and capacity modeling.

If there are any specific legal or procurement stakeholders we should add now, flag them and we'll loop them in.

Thanks —
Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme-corp.com>

Cc: Luke Bennett <luke.bennett@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: kickoff, MAP, and QBR availability

Rafael —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Aug 10 2–3pm ET works best for our cross-functional team. I'll confirm internally that our procurement lead (Tara Lim) can join — if not, she'll be on the follow-up thread.

Quick context that might change the capacity ask: marketing forecasts two major campaigns in Sep that could double inference volume for ~3 weeks. I'll ask Luke to pull the traffic model and share by COB Friday.

We're happy to review the MAP and SOW draft in the QBR. Please include a short slide on rollback/fallback SLAs for burst capacity (we've historically seen bursts cause throttling).

See you Aug 10.

Cheers,
Sarah

--
Sarah Jones
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

Subject: RE: Renewal + Capacity Uplift: kickoff, MAP, and QBR availability

Looping in Neha (CS Lead for Acme) to own the QBR agenda and customer success playbook. Neha — can you draft a 30-minute QBR agenda that covers: current usage + projection, MAP milestones, SOW timeline, and escalation paths for burst events? I'll take the commercial bullets (terms + any discount cadence). Grace, please prepare an engineering note on fallback SLAs and autoscaling options (include latency targets under burst).

Target deliverables before Aug 10 meeting:
- Draft QBR deck (Neha)
- SOW first-pass (Rafael)
- Capacity model + runbook (Grace)

Thanks team — I'll block the calendar once Sarah confirms the procurement attendee.

Marissa

If you can run preliminary cost/throughput scenarios for 1x, 2x, and 3x capacity profiles before the QBR that would help us evaluate options quickly.

Luke
